question: What does the existing suite under flightdeck/testbench/ consist of today, outside suites/_checks/? Report: every suite folder under flightdeck/testbench/suites/ (excluding _checks) with its case count, the flightcrew parts or fc subcommands it exercises (one line each), and the ids its covers line names; the shared helpers (file path and what each exports) that suites import; the fixtures under flightdeck/testbench/fixtures/ and which suites use each; what run-all.mjs does (which folders it runs or skips, hygiene checks, exit codes) and how it names a hygiene failure; and which suites fail today and on which case.
answer: Suite Structure (30 suites, 368 total cases excluding _checks): Each suite folder under flightdeck/testbench/suites/ contains a run.mjs that exercises flightcrew components. The suites are: bin-boundary (14 cases, fc boundary/events), bin-check (19 cases, fc check/verify/baseline), bin-dispatch (16 cases, fc worker render/return/merge/critic render), bin-distribute (6 cases, fc distribute), bin-doctor (7 cases, fc doctor), bin-evidence (7 cases, fc evidence), bin-launch (67 cases, fc launch family + plan write), bin-plan (6 cases, fc plan render), bin-report (8 cases, fc report/budget), bin-runlog (5 cases, fc runlog/launch end), constraints (11 cases, import/package/network/durable-phrase/hygiene scans), crew (9 cases, crew role files), e2e (23 steps covering the full fc command sequence), hook-timing (6 cases, hook performance), hooks-eventlog (23 cases, event-log behavior), hooks-guards (29 cases, lock-guard/boundary-guard), hooks-noop (21 cases, hooks without active launches), hooks-structural (15 cases, structural-check), hooks-stopgate (24 cases, stop-gate blocking and gates), lint-spec (19 cases, spec-readiness-lint rules), manifest (5 cases, MANIFEST.txt validation), run-all (4 cases, testbench/run-all.mjs protocol), schemas (43 cases, every schema file and mutation), templates (13 cases, kickoff library), unit-integration (4 cases, manifest coverage and gate interfaces), validate-launch (13 cases, launch.json defects), validate-plan (15 cases, plan.json rules), validate-spec (1 case per field mutation of golden spec), validate-tests-map (31 cases, tests-map invariants), workflows (4 cases, workflow scripts). Shared Helpers: flightdeck/testbench/lib/suite-lib.mjs exports process runners (fc, sh, hook, run), temp management (tmp), fixture builders (mkLaunchRepo, mkActiveLaunch, initRepo, copyDir), assertions (assert, assertEq, assertMatch, assertIncludes, assertExit), file utilities (readJson, writeJson, readText, writeText, exists, listFiles), and location constants (FD, REPO, FC, FC_MJS, HOOKS, SUITES, FIXTURES, SCHEMAS, CREW, TEMPLATES, WORKFLOWS, MANUALS). Fixtures: flightdeck/testbench/fixtures/ holds sample-project (minimal git repo with test and source files), sample-spec (spec.v1.json, tests-map.v1.json, plan.sample.json, checks/boundary-note.md), sample-launch (fully populated launch with evidence, returns, specs pinned). Suites that call mkLaunchRepo or mkActiveLaunch use these; bin-launch, e2e, schemas, templates, and many others depend on them. run-all.mjs: Runs flightdeck/testbench/suites/*/run.mjs in alphabetical order (skipping directories starting with _ or lacking run.mjs), prints "ok" or "FAIL" with case counts per suite, enforces hygiene by private TMPDIR isolation (any entry left fails the run; removed at exit so no real tmpdir changes) and snapshotting git status before and after (new status outside testbench/runs/ fails), names hygiene failure as "hygiene: FAIL <part>" listing either "new tmpdir entries: <names>" or "new git status lines: <lines>", records testbench/runs/last.json with all results, and exits 0 when every suite passes and hygiene holds, else 2. Failing suites (confirmed): unit-integration fails "every-shipped-file-is-listed-in-the-manifest" case — missing files are launch/specs/flightcrew-characterization/spec.v1.json and manuals/testing/rubric-guide.md (flightdeck/testbench/suites/unit-integration/run.mjs:61-67). crew fails "new-roles-match-the-roster" case with explorer maxTurns: expected 12 got 48 (flightdeck/testbench/suites/crew/run.mjs:158-167).
pointers: flightdeck/testbench/lib/suite-lib.mjs:1-2, :15-28, :99-104, :148-189, :362-395 — helpers exports, locations, tmp, sh/hook/fc/run, suite runner
flightdeck/testbench/fixtures/ — three fixture directories used by mkLaunchRepo/mkActiveLaunch
flightdeck/flightcrew/MANIFEST.txt — lists all shipped files (unit-integration compares against this)
